title: SMOK Nord 4 Replacement Pod
description: With the arrival of the Nord 4, Smok has released the most powerful, feature-packed Nord yet, bursting with performance, innovation and functionality. The Nord 4 features an incredible 2000mAh internal battery that supports a maximum power output of 80W, which when paired with Smok’s sub-ohm RPM 2 and RPM coils delivers unprecedented cloud and flavour production to a compact device that still fits smoothly and discreetly into any pocket or compartment. These replacement Smok Nord 4 pods come with a side-fill port with a silicone stopper, which allows for fast, fuss-free e-liquid refilling. The RPM 2 pod is compatible with Smok’s range of high-performance, long-lasting RPM2 Mesh coils which provide a rich and flavoursome DTL (direct-to-lung) vape, with incredible cloud production. The RPM pod is compatible with Smok’s entire range of Smok’s high-performance, long-lasting RPM coils which provide a sublime, airy MTL (mouth-to-lung) sensation, that’s rich in flavour and perfect for use with Nic Salt, High-PG and 50/50 E-Liquids. Please Note: Coils are not included and must be purchased separately.
